image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rough, grey rocky substrate. The chiton has an oval shape with a distinct reddish-pink leathery girdle surrounding eight overlapping dorsal plates. The plates feature intricate wavy patterns in white and dark brown/black against a pinkish background. The head is at the left (anterior), appearing blunt and indistinct.
